questions.question:
Select the option which is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number.

625 : 25 :: ? : 35
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Product of extremes = Product of means**

**⇒ a : b = c : d **

**⇒ ad = bc**

Given 625 : 25 :: ? : 35

Consider 625 : 25 :: X : 35

⇒ 625 × 35 = 25 × X

⇒ 25X = 21875

⇒ X = 21875 / 25

X = 875

Hence, the correct answer is **"875".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Consider the given information in the statements to be true, even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts, and decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements. .

**Statements:**

All lyricists are morning walkers.

No accountant is graduate.

All morning-walkers are accountants.

**Conclusions:**

I. No lyricist is graduate.

II. Some lyricists are graduates.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f1842d224cc556defa4216f02eb24c0d863e0e32ea9817a268ff3e2a3eb5529.png] 

__**Conclusion:**__

I. No lyricist is graduate → True (As All lyricists are morning walkers and All morning-walkers are accountants and No accountant is graduate so, No lyricist is graduate is true)

II. Some lyricists are graduates → False (As All lyricists are morning walkers and All morning-walkers are accountants and No accountant is graduate so, Some lyricists are graduates is false)

∴ Here, Only Conclusion I is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only Conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
If '+' and '-' and the numbers '5' and '7' (**not a digit)** are interchanged, then what will be the value of the following expression?

18 − 20 ÷ 7 × (15 + 5) + 3
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905e7bfd1fb43c19cdb7ea13bf569e0b6f35154b21eb91bbc576d28a79ae9d75.png] 

**Signs + and - are interchanged.**

**Numbers 5 and 7 are interchanged.**

Given equation : 18 − 20 ÷ 7 × (15 + 5) + 3

After interchanging symbols + and -, numbers 5 and 7 the equation is as follows : 

= 18 + 20 ÷ 5 × (__**15 - 7**__) - 3

= 18 + **__20 ÷ 5__ **× 8 - 3

= 18 + **__4 × 8__** - 3

= __**18 + 32**__ - 3

= **__50__****__ - 3__**

= 47

Hence, the correct answer is **"47".**

questions.question:

questions.solution:

__
 
• Here SMPS__ is repeated.

4) PSMPPS → S **P** P **S - M** M **P** S - **P** M P **S**
